jobs.title: PEDIATRIC HOSPICE RN CASE MANAGER
jobs.description:
PEDIATRIC HOSPICE RN CASE MANAGER JOB DESCRIPTION

Overview

The Hospice Pediatric RN Case Manager will work with our Pediatric team. Primarily responsible for providing professional nursing care to assigned patients. With input from the IDT (interdisciplinary team), patient and family, assesses, develops, implements and evaluates the plan of care. Ensures appropriate communication and plan of care coordination to all internal/external customers

All successful candidates must be fully vaccinated, subject to certain limited exceptions required by applicable law.

Our Mission: To enhance the quality of life for those nearing the end of life’s journey and for those who grieve. We place a high importance on our employees and reward staff in several ways such as:

* Competitive hospice industry compensation

* Benefits package with multiple plan offerings and generous employer contribution

* 401(k) Retirement plan with employer match

* Supportive work culture which encourages work life balance

* Substantial Paid Time Off, paid holidays & birthday benefit

* Employee development program managed by in-house education department to support individualized orientation and professional growth needs.

* Monthly mileage reimbursement

* Employee Referral Program

* Business casual attire for office staff

Responsibilities

JOB DUTIES/KNOWLEDGE/JOB PERFORMANCE:

* Develops written plan of care in coordination with an interdisciplinary Team (IDT).

* Oversees implementation of plan, evaluates and changes plan as necessary to meet patient/family needs.

* Responsible for the direction of care provided by LVN and HA in accordance with patient’s plan of care.

* Responsible for the supervision of services provided by the LVN and HA per TEH policy and regulatory requirements.

* Communicates all changes to IDT and primary MD.

* Performs job duties in clinical areas as stated in clinical competency checklist, policies/procedures, standards of care, and critical competencies based on Scope of Practice.

* Maintains timely patient documentation using “point care” electronic charting.

* Implements and maintains established hospice policies and procedures as well as Standards of Care and regulatory requirements.

* Provides health care instruction to patient and family members.

* Orients, instructs, and trains assigned personnel.

* Participates in providing 24 hour, seven days a week coverage to patients/families (on-call and census fluctuation).

* Performs admission assessment and admission when necessary.

  

DEGREE OF TRAVEL: • Travel required for patient visits. • Occasional travel for educational purposes.

Qualifications:

* Must have Associates Degree, Bachelor Degree preferred.

* Must have one year of acute or hospice pediatric experience

* At least 12 months experience with 1-2 years preferred in acute care.

* Current CA RN license.

* Current CA driver’s license with proof of insurance.

• Current CPR/BLS • Prefer certification as hospice nurse.

* Pediatric experience preferred.

* Proof of recent TB test result

* Bilingual preferred.

* Computer skills (word processing), use of adding machine, calculator, fax, photocopier.

jobs.title: Community Health Worker - Los Angeles area
jobs.description:
**Reliance Hospice and Palliative Care** is actively seeking an experienced **Community Health Worker (Medical Assistant)** to support patients and families throughout the **Los Angeles area**.

This is a **field-based position** for a highly experienced, professional, and compassionate individual who is comfortable spending most of the day traveling between **patient homes, healthcare facilities, and referral sources** and meeting directly with patients and families.

**Hourly compensation starts at $25/hour and up, depending on experience.**

The ideal candidate will have a strong healthcare background, excellent **customer service and interpersonal skills**, and experience communicating with patients, families, healthcare professionals, and referral partners. Hospice or palliative care experience, as well as healthcare outreach or sales experience, is required.

**JOB DESCRIPTION SUMMARY**

The Community Health Worker is responsible for providing patients and families with clear explanations and education regarding hospice and palliative care benefits, helping ensure timely access to services, and increasing community awareness of Reliance Hospice & Palliative Care.

The CHW will also assist with communication between the agency and referral sources and develop relationships within the healthcare and local community.

Responsibilities include:

* Meet with patients and families in **homes, healthcare facilities, and other community settings**.
* Explain hospice and palliative care services and benefits in a clear, compassionate, and professional manner.
* Provide excellent customer service and serve as a positive representative of Reliance Hospice & Palliative Care.
* Build and maintain relationships with referral sources, healthcare professionals, community organizations, and families.
* Conduct community outreach and education for healthcare professionals, civic leaders, and members of the public.
* Assist with communication between patients, families, referral sources, and the agency.
* Travel throughout the assigned Los Angeles service area as needed.
* Demonstrate compassion and professionalism when working with patients and families facing life-limiting illness, death, or bereavement.
* Independently coordinate activities while maintaining strong organization and follow-through.

POSITION QUALIFICATIONS

* High school diploma or GED required; Associate's or Bachelor's degree preferred, or equivalent work experience.
* **At least 2 years of hospice and/or palliative care experience required.**
* Previous **healthcare sales, business development, community outreach, or referral development experience required**.
* Strong **customer service and interpersonal skills**.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, public relations, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to communicate tactfully and compassionately with patients, families, referral sources, and community partners.
* Professional, confident, and comfortable **working in the field and meeting with patients and families throughout the day**.
* Ability to work independently, organize activities, and manage multiple priorities.
* Bilingual in **Spanish is preferred**.
* Reliable transportation and willingness to drive to patient homes, facilities, and referral locations.
* Ability to meet the physical requirements of the position.

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: From $25.00 per hour

Experience:

* Customer service: 3 years (Required)
* Hospice & palliative medicine: 2 years (Required)

Language:

* Spanish (Preferred)

Work Location: On the road
